output.summary: The evidence supports that RR-17 routing of SlotBook tickets to the P4 best-effort queue explains about 70% of the Arts resolution gap (E4, E6), and that the auto-acknowledgement never disclosed the best-effort status (E7). Category-matched Arts tickets are not slower than other faculties' tickets (E4), so the deprioritisation hypothesis is contradicted. Arts' volume excess is not fully explained by SlotBook, and the SSO link is contradicted (E15). Whether ITS told Arts leadership about RR-17 remains unknown, since the one attendee declined interview (E8). The remaining gap is plausibly due to Lindqvist on-site coverage (E5). Cheap fixes (SlotBook support agreement, accurate acknowledgements, a split reporting) are preferred; putting all Arts tickets on P4 is harmful, and CampusBook migration and the 2 FTE transfer are premature.
